wiktionary.format: Kaikki postprocessed per-language JSONL; deprecated upstream, not raw Wiktextract data
wiktionary.modifications: Retain 3–11-tile German headwords, excluding proper-name POS, with Zipf >=2.5, parts of speech, glosses, sense tags and form/alternative relationships only. Omit enrichment categories, disambiguation, audio, examples, quotations, translations, etymology and non-Latin forms. Preserve original headwords and per-record input hashes. NFC preserves umlauts. Sharp s becomes capital ẞ, a distinct single tile. No transliteration. Only A–Z, Ä, Ö, Ü, ẞ are playable. Exact source spelling and case are retained. No exact article revision is supplied by this snapshot.

wordfreq.author: Robyn Speer and contributors
wordfreq.modifications: Retain 3–11-letter spelling frequency bins matching lexical evidence. Use upstream Unicode casefolded spelling frequency: sharp-s and ss share frequency estimates only, never gameplay keys. This can inflate either sense; editorial review is separate. For case-normalized homographs use the maximum supplied estimate, not a sum. Historical mixed-corpus spelling frequencies do not certify individual senses or contemporary regional usage.
